label: Jagjaguwar
release_notes: Fourth album from Max Clarke as Cut Worms; produced by Jeff Tweedy at Wilco's Loft studio in Chicago.
Reviewers hear a darker, richer record than earlier Cut Worms, still built on 1960s and 1970s pop.
The library has his 2023 self-titled album (tag 1149678) but not this one.
draft_comment: Max Clarke hands the keys to Jeff Tweedy and the jangle gets darker and richer. Big Star melodies, Replacements heartache, zero filler.
